say:0:1110705001:0.text: He didn't want his grave to take up space where our people lived...
say:0:1110705001:0.source_cn: 老爹临终前，让我们把他埋在边缘……他不愿让他的坟墓占据...

say:1:1110705002:0.text: ... But it's not like our clan was that big back then.

say:2:1110705003:0.text: I'm sure he believed that the clan would thrive under your guidance.
say:2:1110705003:0.source_cn: 那是因为他相信，乌尔氏族会在你们手中壮大吧。
say:2:1110705003:0.male: I'm sure he believed that the clan would thrive under your guidance.
say:2:1110705003:0.female: I'm sure he believed that the clan would thrive under your guidance.

say:3:1110705004:0.text: Hmm... It's only been a short while, but there's more gravel up there now... Let's clean it up...
say:3:1110705004:0.source_cn: 嗯……才多久没来，上面就多了一些沙砾……我们清扫下吧……
